votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the State Street Community Reinvestment Area Budget Amendment
votes.description: Motion to close the public hearing on the proposed resolution to amend the 20-year consolidated budget for the State Street Community Reinvestment Area.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 06 of 2023 – State Street Community Reinvestment Area Budget Amendment
votes.description: Motion to adopt a resolution amending the 20-year consolidated budget for the State Street Community Reinvestment Area to align it with executed interlocal agreements with Salt Lake City, Salt Lake City School District, and Salt Lake County.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda (Board Re-appointment: Redevelopment Advisory Committee - Mojdeh Sakaki)
votes.description: Motion to approve the consent agenda, which includes the re-appointment of Mojdeh Sakaki to the Redevelopment Advisory Committee for a term ending January 18, 2027.
